## Summary
Seed LCME accreditation standards, IPEC interprofessional competencies, CarePhase nodes, and anatomy region hierarchy into Neo4j — the regulatory, competency, and anatomical reference layers of the knowledge graph.

## User story
As a curriculum administrator, I need LCME standards, IPEC competencies, care phases, and anatomy regions in the knowledge graph, so that content can be mapped to accreditation requirements and clinical anatomy for compliance reporting.

## Why this matters
LCME accreditation is non-negotiable for MSM. If LCME standards are missing from the graph, curriculum mapping reports cannot verify coverage. IPEC competencies drive interprofessional education requirements. Anatomy regions are required for clinical vignette contextualization. Missing any of these blocks downstream compliance and content generation features.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] LCME_Standard nodes created for all current LCME standards
- [ ] LCME standards include element-level granularity (standard -> element hierarchy)
- [ ] IPEC_Competency nodes created for all 4 IPEC core competency domains
- [ ] IPEC sub-competencies linked to parent domains via HAS_SUBCOMPETENCY edge
- [ ] CarePhase nodes created for all clinical care phases
- [ ] AnatomyRegion nodes created with hierarchical relationships (region -> sub-region)
- [ ] All nodes carry institution_id for tenant isolation (Rule 1)
- [ ] All seeds are idempotent (MERGE, not CREATE)
- [ ] All scripts use neo4jQuery wrapper (Rule 1)

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// scripts/seeds/06-lcme-standards.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'

const LCME_STANDARDS = [
  { code: '1', title: 'Mission, Planning, Organization, and Integrity', elements: [
    { code: '1.1', title: 'Strategic Planning and Continuous Quality Improvement' },
    // ...
  ]},
  // ...
]

async function seedLCMEStandards(institutionId: string) {
  for (const standard of LCME_STANDARDS) {
    await neo4jQuery(
      `MERGE (s:LCME_Standard {code: $code, institution_id: $institution_id})
       ON CREATE SET s.uuid = randomUUID(), s.title = $title, s.created_at = datetime()
       ON MATCH SET s.title = $title, s.updated_at = datetime()`,
      { code: standard.code, title: standard.title },
      institutionId
    )
    for (const element of standard.elements) {
      await neo4jQuery(
        `MATCH (s:LCME_Standard {code: $standard_code, institution_id: $institution_id})
         MERGE (e:LCME_Element {code: $code, institution_id: $institution_id})
         ON CREATE SET e.uuid = randomUUID(), e.title = $title, e.standard_code = $standard_code, e.created_at = datetime()
         ON MATCH SET e.title = $title, e.updated_at = datetime()
         MERGE (s)-[:HAS_ELEMENT]->(e)`,
        { standard_code: standard.code, code: element.code, title: element.title },
        institutionId
      )
    }
  }
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-01: Raw neo4j-driver import
import neo4j from 'neo4j-driver'  // BANNED

// ✗ CREATE instead of MERGE
await neo4jQuery('CREATE (s:LCME_Standard ...)', ...)  // WRONG — not idempotent

// ✗ Missing hierarchy edges — orphaned elements
// Every LCME_Element MUST have a HAS_ELEMENT edge from its parent LCME_Standard
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E01/E01-S06.seed.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'

const TEST_INSTITUTION = process.env.TEST_INSTITUTION_ID ?? 'test-institution-001'

test('Acceptance: LCME_Standard nodes exist', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (s:LCME_Standard {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(s) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records[0].count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(8)
})

test('Acceptance: every LCME_Element has parent standard', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    `MATCH (e:LCME_Element {institution_id: $institution_id})
     WHERE NOT (:LCME_Standard)-[:HAS_ELEMENT]->(e)
     RETURN count(e) as orphans`,
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records[0].orphans).toBe(0)
})

test('Acceptance: 4 IPEC competency domains exist', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (c:IPEC_Competency {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(c) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records[0].count).toBe(4)
})

test('Acceptance: IPEC sub-competencies linked to domains', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    `MATCH (sc:IPEC_SubCompetency {institution_id: $institution_id})
     WHERE NOT (:IPEC_Competency)-[:HAS_SUBCOMPETENCY]->(sc)
     RETURN count(sc) as orphans`,
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records[0].orphans).toBe(0)
})

test('Acceptance: CarePhase nodes exist', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (cp:CarePhase {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(cp) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records[0].count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4)
})

test('Acceptance: AnatomyRegion hierarchy is valid', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (ar:AnatomyRegion {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(ar) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records[0].count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(10)
})

test('Acceptance: all nodes have institution_id', async () => {
  const labels = ['LCME_Standard', 'LCME_Element', 'IPEC_Competency', 'IPEC_SubCompetency', 'CarePhase', 'AnatomyRegion']
  for (const label of labels) {
    const result = await neo4jQuery(
      `MATCH (n:${label}) WHERE n.institution_id IS NULL RETURN count(n) as orphans`,
      {},
      TEST_INSTITUTION
    )
    if (result) {
      expect(result.records[0].orphans).toBe(0)
    }
  }
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. Remove all seeded nodes:
   ```cypher
   MATCH (n) WHERE n:LCME_Standard OR n:LCME_Element OR n:IPEC_Competency OR n:IPEC_SubCompetency OR n:CarePhase OR n:AnatomyRegion DETACH DELETE n
   ```
2. `git stash && git checkout develop`
